safety_privacy_statement: MEDAI-V2-VALIDATION-HARNESS-01 is a reports-only / validation-harness-only block. It adds a typing-only Python catalog module (clinical_knowledge/v2_contracts/validation_harness.py), an audit script, a focused pytest module, and three public-safe reports. The catalog module imports only the standard library (dataclasses, enum, typing) and has no runtime side effects on import. No V1 validation script was modified. No app/main.py / launcher / startup preflight / config / helper / Streamlit-wiring modification. No license text was reproduced. No licensed terminology rows were read. No private license-acknowledgement file contents were read. No private config contents were read. No terminology_data/, data/terminology/, runtime DB, or source document contents were opened. No private filesystem paths were printed. No raw text, raw OCR text, raw document text, raw filenames, PHI, keys, or secrets appear in any committed file. No external API was called or enabled. No tags created, moved, or deleted. PARK-20..26 tag pairs, the FREEZE tag pair, the term helper/wiring PARK-01 tag pair, and the license-gate PARK-02 tag pair all remain intact. Private adapter implementation and real private-store access remain explicitly BLOCKED. Cue expansion remains explicitly NOT recommended.
